name: ai-resources
description: ai-resources kit: agy-cli (Antigravity CLI), agy-cli-lane (the Antigravity lane backend, ADR-0007) and claude-kit (unrestricted Claude Code) CLI backends, plus the /claude and /equipo shortcut commands and the native team orchestrator (/workflow run|status|approve|cancel|resume).

agyBin.description: Absolute path to the agy binary.

claudeBin.description: Absolute path to the claude binary.

python3Bin.description: Absolute path to python3, used by the agy MCP bridge.

serializeAgy.description: Whether to serialize agy-cli runs globally into a single queue. Defaults to false (concurrent runs per channel).

kitRoot.description: Absolute path to ai-resources libexec root.

enableOrchestrator.description: Enable native lifecycle team orchestration and cockpit commands.

aiResourcesBin.description: Absolute path to the ai-resources executable that runs the orchestrator engine (default: python3 <kitRoot>/scripts/kit.py).

maxTeams.description: How many orchestrated teams may work at once; the rest wait in a FIFO queue. Default 2.

roleTimeouts.description: Seconds a step of a role may run, e.g. {"planner": 1200, "implementer": 9000}. Defaults: planner 1200, implementer 9000, tester 2700, verifier 1800, others 1800.

runsDir.description: Directory of orchestrator run state. Default: $XDG_STATE_HOME/ai-resources/runs (never under /tmp).
